purpose: Photo-based conceptual CAD; dimensions are assumed, not manufacturing dimensions.
notes: The geometry was visually approximated from the supplied image.
Cable bends are modeled as segmented round solids rather than exact spline sweeps.
3D DXF contains MESH entities organized by layer and can be opened in AutoCAD then saved as DWG.
STEP is the preferred editable 3D CAD interchange file for this concept model.
